SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    AVG(ss_quantity) AS agg1, 
    AVG(ss_list_price) AS agg2, 
    AVG(ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3, 
    AVG(ss_sales_price) AS agg4 
FROM 
    store_sales 
JOIN 
    date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk 
    AND date_dim.d_year = 2001 
JOIN 
    (SELECT p_promo_sk FROM promotion WHERE p_channel_email = 'N' OR p_channel_event = 'N') AS filtered_promotion 
    ON store_sales.ss_promo_sk = filtered_promotion.p_promo_sk 
JOIN 
    (SELECT cd_demo_sk FROM customer_demographics 
     WHERE cd_gender = 'F' 
     AND cd_marital_status = 'W' 
     AND cd_education_status = 'College') AS filtered_demographics 
    ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = filtered_demographics.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN 
    item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk 
GROUP BY 
    i_item_id 
ORDER BY 
    i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
